title: Total degree bound for a low-degree squarefree polynomial
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and fix $n, D \in \bbn$. For any assignment of coefficients $c \colon \mathcal{S}_{n,D} \to K$, indexed by the subsets $s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ with $\abs{s} \le D$, the polynomial
\[
\sum_{\substack{s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n \\ \abs{s} \le D}} c(s)\, \prod_{i \in s} X_i \in K[X_0, \dots, X_{n-1}]
\]
has total degree at most $D$.
hypotheses_covered: coefficient function $c$ on the low-degree squarefree supports $\mathcal{S}_{n,D}$ (subsets $s\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ with $|s|\le D$)
replaced:
For any coefficient function $c$ on $\texttt{ACP.LowDegreeSupport}\ n\ D$, the polynomial
$\texttt{ACP.lowDegreeSquarefreePolynomial}\ c$ has total degree at most $D$.
